rods.name: Willow Switch
rods.flavor: A bendy stick, a length of string, and boundless optimism. The fish are not intimidated, which is exactly how you'll catch them.

rods.name: Ashwood Angler
rods.flavor: Sanded smooth by someone who clearly cared, then sold to you by someone who clearly didn't. Smells faintly of campfires and second chances.

rods.name: Riverwarden's Cane
rods.flavor: Copper-ferruled and river-tested by three generations of wardens who all retired happy. The current whispers to it, and it politely whispers back.

rods.name: Lakekeeper's Longpole
rods.flavor: Long enough to reach the deep middle water where the smug fish live. Comes with a small brass bell that rings only when it feels like it.

rods.name: Saltspray Longcast
rods.flavor: Whip it forward and the line sails clean past the breakers, humming a sailor's tune. The salt has cured the wood into something that no longer fears weather, or much of anything.

rods.name: Coralsong Spire
rods.flavor: Grown, not built, in a reef garden where the polyps hum in harmony. Cast it and the water blooms with colour, as if the ocean is showing off for you.

rods.name: Marshlight Snare
rods.flavor: Lacquered in swamp-witch resin and strung with sewer-silk, it glows a gentle green wherever honest light refuses to go. The murk holds no secrets from it, only appointments.

rods.name: Glacierheart Rod
rods.flavor: Its core is a sliver of thousand-year ice that refuses to melt out of sheer stubbornness. Hold it steady and the whole world seems to slow down and breathe.

rods.name: Rigline Colossus
rods.flavor: Welded from salvaged derrick steel and enough cable to moor a small nation. It doesn't cast so much as launch, and the deep sea has learned to take it seriously.

rods.name: Abysscaller
rods.flavor: Its line vanishes into black water and keeps going long after the ocean should have ended. Sometimes, when the night is very quiet, something at the other end tugs first.

rods.name: Calderaforged Fang
rods.flavor: Quenched in a volcanic spring and cooled in a glacier lake, it still can't decide which one it prefers. The grip stays warm as fresh bread, even in a blizzard.

rods.name: The Leviathan's Toothpick
rods.flavor: Carved from a single rib of something the charts only call HERE BE, strung with a filament of dawn. When you cast it, the horizon leans in to watch.
